mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% and 0.3% respectively in a month signals a robust consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both RSAFS increased by more than 1% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over three months signals a deflationary pressure, which increases real returns on fixed income investments and reduces the relative attractiveness of equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% and 0.2% respectively in a quarter signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 0.5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 increased by more than 0.5% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% in the previous quarter.
